Q: Why is there no spreadsheets.file scope similar to drive.file for user-selected Sheets only? A:

That seems to be an app script exclusive scope, not documented in the OAuth2 scopes. Have you used it with OAuth scope? Not sure what currentonly could mean there

Q: Recommended languages/APIs/frameworks for an online turned based word game A:

There are too many ways to implement a game. The choice of a language and frameworks should depend on you, not on us, because it also depends on your personal preferences. As to Python, you have to be aware of performance limitations, especially if you are not using compilation. However, word games don't seem to be demanding in terms of performance, except for those solving very complicated linguistic problems.

Q: Why do i have both `/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator` and `~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator` A:

Your user ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator contains (in Devices) the contents of your simulators, one per device type (e.g. the iPhone SE third generation simulator, if you have created one). You can even drill down and see the apps installed on those simulators.

The top-level /Library/Developer/CoreSimulator contains (in Volumes) the mounted images of the simulator runtimes you have downloaded, one per system (e.g. iOS 26.4.1). You can find a list of these in the Components tab of the Xcode Settings window. If you don't see them, launch Xcode.
